title: A gap-research story's check counts a closing note only when it cites a tagged article fact
goal: the check a gap-research story carries counts a Resolved, Partly resolved, Narrowed or Closed note as closing only when the note cites a tagged article fact by path:line, so a closing on a code read or a local run with no fact behind it fails the item's done; the closings of 2026-10-21 that cite no fact are re-read against the rule
notes: Retrospective of SP-5cyrnkw7 and SP-z6wolmvm (2026-10-22, operator accepted): the gap stories' checks counted any closing word as closed; the fresh reviews found 3 run-based closings in C (fixed by ST-5p46sliz) and 34 gitlab closings in D with no article fact or source row (fixed by ST-xfuucxk2). On origin/main of 2026-10-22 the draft check lists 213 closings dated 2026-10-2x across other domains that cite no article fact by path:line; many may cite source ids the article holds, so planning decides whether a cited source id counts.
